claim_map.title: Rule UI and service responsibilities
claim_map.text: Reuse the netting-rule blotter with an auto-netting checkbox. Auto rules require booking entity, currency, and shifter; shifter supports hours and minutes. PendingAutoNetting cannot SettleAsGross. Static service calculates auto-netting time. Rule service supports isAutoNetting, update/delete, validation, duplication checks, and exclusions. A rule hit returns VD plus shifter and triggers IsAutoNettingEligible.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: Lifecycle execution predicates
claim_map.text: Lifecycle stores job_time and computes it from VD plus shifter. Query WAITING with PendingAutoNetting by booking entity, currency, counterparty, value date, and job time. Lock target cashflows. At or after job time, net groups larger than one. For exactly one, SettleAsSingle returns QUEUED and a Single Cashflow NSTP exception applies. Before job time, do nothing. Record execution results. The SingleCashflow XPath remains pending; naming differs from SettleAsSingle. Insert the orchestration step between netting eligibility and SSI stamping. The prose15-minute schedule and printed cron expression are unresolved.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: Amendment-task ordering
claim_map.text: The short process flow collects auto-netting tasks, removes amendment cashflows from those tasks, and then performs auto-netting. It specifies no matching identity, retained version, transaction boundary, retry, or race handling. Do not infer them from the ordering alone.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

owner_questions.question: Which scheduler syntax, cadence, timezone, and SingleCashflow contract are approved?
owner_questions.investigation: Technical prose says every15minutes but shows 0 */15 * * *. Indicator naming varies between SettleAsSingle and SingleCashflow; XPath is pending.
owner_questions.consequence: Cannot select an executable scheduler or complete downstream indicator schema.
owner_questions.next_action: Root consolidates in the existing central batch question file.

owner_questions.question: Which calendar, shifter, single-flow, locking, and retry contract apply?
owner_questions.investigation: Design supplies grouping/job-time comparisons and locking but lacks complete concurrency/recovery and calendar rules.
owner_questions.consequence: Cannot claim safe scheduler execution from static design.
owner_questions.next_action: Root consolidates in the existing central batch question file.

owner_questions.question: Which identity, ordering, race, and retry rules govern amendment-task removal?
owner_questions.investigation: The short Auto Netting design orders collect tasks, remove amendment cashflows, then net. It supplies no removal predicate or transaction boundary.
owner_questions.consequence: Cannot infer which amendment version remains eligible or how retries recover.
owner_questions.next_action: Root consolidates in the existing central batch question file.
